title: What Makes a Kingfisher Stand Out?
caption:
BLUE FEATHERS AND A POINTED BILL. Distinct real common kingfishers filmed beside different waterways. #WildVox #Kingfisher #Birdwatching

narration_timeline.text: Bright blue feathers draw attention to this common kingfisher, but its long pointed bill is equally distinctive.
In another view, a kingfisher preens its feathers while staying on a perch.
Different birds pause beside water, turning and watching from their separate resting places.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: 2022-01-14 LJUBLJANA Špica CORACIIFORMES Alcedo atthis VODOMEC.webm and Common kingfisher (Alcedo atthis) in Slovakia.webm

narration_timeline.text: At two more waterways, branches and greenery frame these small birds as they remain perched.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: 2022-09-01 VRHNIKA Ribniki pri stari opekarni CORACIIFORMES Alcedo atthis VODOMEC.webm and 2022-07-23 RIBNIKI V DOLINI DRAGE CORACIIFORMES Alcedo atthis VODOMEC.webm

narration_timeline.text: A more distant kingfisher stays near its own patch of vegetation, harder to pick out.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: 2022-07-25 VRHNIKA Ribniki pri stari opekarni CORACIIFORMES Alcedo atthis VODOMEC.webm

narration_timeline.text: Even from farther away, the small silhouette and pointed bill can reveal where the kingfisher sits.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Common Kingfisher eating a fish.webm
